XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure to start, air conditioning inactive, fault warning lights on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | ACCESSORIES | FAILURE | STARTING | ENGINE | WARNING | LOCK | FUEL | FLASHING | SPEEDOMETER | CLOCK | AIR CONDITIONING | INACTIVE | U0422 | P0657 | U1706 | P0504

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: injection

  • Device: ignition lock

  • Fault: Engine will not start, air conditioning and panoramic roof opening do not work, fault warning lights come on, speedometer and clock flash, outside temperature is not displayed, 'FUEL BLOCK NOT AVAILABLE' warning, pressing the brake pedal turns off the instrument panel.
  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0422, P0657, U1706, P0504

  • Cause: faulty ignition switch

• Intervention: replacement of the electrical part of the ignition block

  • Procedure: after replacement, programming via self-diagnostic tester is not necessary

  • Notes: intervention time approximately 10 minutes
